device: iPhone 18 Pro simulator (CrewCue wf_2eeffd66-797-1, 21B8A630), iOS 27.0, Debug build; iPhone Duo simulator (CrewCue wf_2eeffd66-797-1 Duo, 877D275D) outer display; iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator (CrewCue wf_2eeffd66-797-1 Max, B5D44BD9) portrait and landscape for regular width
session: Dev session (HS256 dev JWT) as a new runner against the local memory API on 127.0.0.1:3000, launched through crewcue://dev/app-shell. Each run used a fresh runner with an unpaid race that had finished phase 1: the 50K course with aids saved by PUT /course, a start two days out, account and history done and the teaser marked in the onboarding progress file, so the gate opened the replay. An XCUITest driver (not committed) tapped and took a screenshot about every 0.8 s while an accessibility snapshot logged the visible Last ping, finish ETA and caption text. Purchase went through the Debug fake store (FakeDevPurchaser, POST billing/dev-purchase), so the paywall prices are the BillingProduct fallbacks ($14.99, $19.99), not StoreKit localized prices. Offline: --api-base-url pointed at a closed port. Blocker: iPhone Duo inner display and a switch between the Duo displays mid-replay were not run. The inner display (2007x2853) stays black on this Xcode and the fold is not scriptable from simctl or XCUITest, so regular width was shown on the Pro Max in landscape instead, with a rotation mid-replay that continued from the same moment. Also found: launching a real dev session without --deeplink (the splash path in CrewCueApp.body) trapped on a main-actor isolation assertion in about 4 of 6 launches on iOS 27.0; every run here passed --deeplink crewcue://dev/app-shell, which skips the splash. That path is not changed by this PR.
action: Replay on the runner's own course (Tahoe 50K proof, 31.0 mi): the dot moved from the start through Aid 1 to Aid 2 to mile 19, Last ping reset to just now at each ping. Beat 2: Finish ETA 7:54 PM then 7:58 then 8:02 PM on Pace. Beat 3: Last ping 8, 11, 14 then 18 min ago ('Runner signal is stale'), then just now when the saved pings arrived together. Beat 4: the crew message 'Saw your pings come back in...' arrived in Chat. The replay ended on the paywall at about 25 s. Skip at 6 s opened the paywall, Back replayed from the start, Not now landed on the tab bar with the Unlock race banner and a relaunch stayed on the tab bar. A second runner bought Race Pass with the debug purchaser and landed on the tab bar with no Unlock race banner. A third was killed at 12 s (dead zone beat) and relaunched: the replay restarted from beat 1. A fourth rotated to landscape on the Pro Max during beat 2 and kept playing from the same beat; the Pace and Map panes showed side by side. A fifth, with the API unreachable, showed the Offline copy with Skip.

checked.Success: Compact (iPhone 18 Pro, Duo outer display, Pro Max portrait): one view at a time following the beats with a Map/Pace/Chat strip. Captions '1 of 4' to '4 of 4'. Last ping: just now / 3 min ago / 18 min ago / just now. Map footer 'Next aid station Finish 7:50 PM'. Pace: Aid 1 and Aid 2 rows 'Locked', note 'Aid station times stay locked until you unlock the race.' Chat: 'Your crew 5:32 PM, Saw your pings come back in. We'll be ready at the next aid.' with no message field, no send button and no photo picker. Paywall: 'You + 1 crew' with 'Buy Race Pass, $14.99' and 'Your whole crew' with 'Buy Race Pass + Full Crew, $19.99', Redeem code and Not now. After Not now: tab bar with Unlock race. After a debug purchase: tab bar, no Unlock race, race paid.
checked.Empty: Not run on a real race: a race with no course never reaches the replay gate (setup needs the course). The Empty state on the real screen is covered by OnboardingRacePreviewTests with ?state=empty.
checked.Error: Covered by OnboardingRacePreviewTests with ?state=error ('Couldn't play the replay. Skip to unlock your race.'); not reproduced against the API.
checked.Offline: API unreachable, new runner with no saved room: 'Offline. The replay plays from the race saved on this phone.' with Skip, and Skip opened the paywall.
